Common questions, answered plainly.

Search the questions below or browse by topic. Where a detail is not confirmed, the answer says so instead of guessing.

GeneralCoursesAdmissionsLearning

General

What is ANCA?
ANCA is the short name for Abhishek Naag Coaching Academy, a Commerce-focused coaching academy in Kopar Khairane, Navi Mumbai.
Where is ANCA located?
ANCA is located in Kopar Khairane, Navi Mumbai. Use the location guidance to plan a visit.

Courses

Which pathways are listed?
The listed pathways are 11th Commerce, 12th Commerce, CA Foundation, CMA Foundation, and ICSE. Current availability should be confirmed with the academy.
How do I choose a course?
Start with the learner’s current class, academic goal, and questions. The Courses page gives a clear overview of each listed pathway.

Admissions

How can I enquire?
Use the enquiry form on the Contact page and include the learner’s class and course of interest.
What should I include in a message?
Share the student’s current class, preferred pathway, questions, and the best way for the academy to respond.

Learning support

What does the learning approach focus on?
ANCA’s published approach highlights concept clarity, regular practice, personal attention, doubt support, and exam-focused preparation.
Are notes and downloads available?
The resource page is static-ready. Verified notes and downloads will be added when the academy publishes the relevant files.

Need a direct answer?

Ask ANCA directly.

Use the contact form for course or availability questions.
